evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: It's just so hectic moving... I'm kind of nervous, wish to have a good mover so I can trust — a real trust concern surfaced late in the call and got only a passing acknowledgment, no real follow-up
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Does that make sense so far?

top_strength: Handled a long, complicated add-on list (fragile plant waiver, washer/dryer shipping bolts) patiently and recalculated the estimate accurately each time new items came up.
coaching_note: When the customer voiced a real trust/anxiety concern near the end, it got a shrug-level response instead of real follow-up, and there was no close attempt at all — that's exactly the moment to lean into Save Your Ass and ask for the booking.
